Verisign Inc (NASDAQ:VRSN) Sellers Rose Their Shorts By 2.19% Posted by Glen Chin on December 21, 2018 at 8:38 pm
Verisign Inc (NASDAQ:VRSN) reported an increase of 2.19% in shorted shares. In December was published VRSN’s total 2.17 million shorted shares by FINRA. Previously was reported up change of 2.19% from 2.12M shares. Verisign Inc (NASDAQ:VRSN) has 1.32 million shares average volume. It’ll cost 2 days for VRSN to recover its former position.
VRSN reached $143.21 during the last trading session after $3.81 change.VeriSign, Inc. has volume of 861,485 shares. Since December 21, 2017 VRSN has risen 39.16% and is uptrending. VRSN outperformed by 39.16% the S&P500.
VeriSign, Inc. provides domain name registry services and Internet security worldwide.The company has $17.31 billion market cap. The firm offers registry services that operate the authoritative directory of .com, .net, .cc, .tv, and .name domain names, as well as the back-end systems for .gov, .jobs, .edu, and other domain names.35.12 is the P/E ratio. The Company’s registry services allow individuals and organizations to establish their online identities. VeriSign, Inc. (NASDAQ:VRSN) Ratings Coverage
